ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown, $\triangle ABO \sim \triangle CDO$, if $BO = 10$, $DO = 5$, and $AC = 9$, then what is the length of $OC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\triangle ABO\sim \triangle CDO$,\\
it follows that $\frac{OB}{OD}=\frac{OA}{OC}$,\\
therefore $\frac{10}{5}=\frac{9-OC}{OC}$,\\
solving this yields $OC=\boxed{3}$.
